<function name="GetPos" parent="CLuaEmitter" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the position of this emitter. This is set when creating the emitter with <page>Global.ParticleEmitter</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">Position of this particle emitter.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
